_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 6 object handlers: hopping enemies $10-$13 ($9C1D-$9D09). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): first frame?
regions.description: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): type bit 7 set goes to the per-frame code (`$9C67`). Stats of the four types: collision flags 0, drawing flags 3, art block `$16`, dies as type 8; hit points 24 / 32 / 48 / 80, attack 32 / 64 / 88 / 128 (the area 5-6 values: they pass through the area scaling `$FE88` below, unlike the ground enemies `$0E` / `$0F` that have tier tables of their own).

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): palette and hop mask by type
regions.description: `$0560` := `$9CDE[type]` (`$9CEE`: palette `01 02 00 03`) and `$07D0` := `$9CF2[type]` (`$9D02`: `03 01 00 05`), the mask that decides which hops aim at the player. Hit points are not touched here.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): art wait
regions.description: `JSR $C0A8` (`$CF5F`): without its block the object waits; with it the same call loads the table stats (`$CFA0`).

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): area scaling
regions.description: `JSR $C162` (`$FE88`): attack and hit points by the area, 1/8 in area 0 up to x4 in areas 9-10. RUN: hit points 24 / 32 / 48 / 80 and attack 32 / 64 / 88 / 128 at area 5; area 0: hit points 3 / 4 / 6 / 10, attack 4 / 8 / 11 / 16; area 9: hit points 96 / 128 / 192 / 255, attack 128 / 255 / 255 / 255 (capped).

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): random placement
regions.description: `$0728` (the hit box bottom) non-zero means a spawner gave a position; otherwise `JSR $C0F3` (`$FA17`: random x 32-223, y 40-183). Unlike the ground enemies there is no cell test.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): picture
regions.description: Metasprite `$19` for all four types.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): speed class
regions.description: `$0698` := 1 (0.47 px a frame for a hop's aimed velocity).

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): gravity target
regions.description: `$0668` := `$FF`: the y target of the spring in `$9CC7`, far below the screen, so the spring is a constant downward pull.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): introduction
regions.description: `$0788` := `$28`: 40 frames of flickering arrival.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): landing level
regions.description: `$07A0` := the y it was placed at: the level it lands on.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): set-up
regions.description: `JSR $C0A2` (animation phase 0).

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): every frame: introduction
regions.description: `JSR $C009` (`$FD53`): during the 40 frames it draws on every second frame and the rest of the handler is skipped.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): rising?
regions.description: A negative y speed `$05D8` goes to the spring and the picture (`$9CC7`): nothing else happens on the way up.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): falling: tile base
regions.description: `$06C8` := block base + 4: the picture while falling.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): landed?
regions.description: y `$0518` below the landing level `$07A0` (unsigned compare) goes to the spring: it keeps falling. Reaching it with a non-negative y speed starts the next hop. RUN: the first hop starts on the first frame after the introduction, since y equals the level.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): count the hop
regions.description: `$07B8` is incremented.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): aim at the player?
regions.description: (`$07B8` AND `$07D0`) = 0 aims at the player; non-zero goes straight down.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): no: direction 4
regions.description: A := 4 (down): the speed class 1 velocity of direction 4 has no x part, so a non-aimed hop stops any sideways drift.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): yes: aim
regions.description: `JSR $C0FF` (`$F863`): A := the direction (0-15) from this object to the player.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): keep the direction
regions.description: `PHA`.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): velocity
regions.description: `JSR $C102` (`$F8CE`): x and y speed from the direction and the speed class 1 (0.47 px a frame at most).

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): the kick: random part
regions.description: The y speed's fraction `$05C0` is lowered by a random 0-31 (the carry from the random routine is left in, so it can be one more).

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): the kick: 3 px up
regions.description: `$05D8` (y speed, whole part) -= 3 with `SEC`. RUN: y speed -3 + 0.3-0.6 = about -2.4 px a frame at the start of every hop, whatever the direction.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): the direction back
regions.description: `PLA / TAY`.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): a straight hop lands at the same level
regions.description: (`$07B8` AND `$07D0`) non-zero: Y := 0, so the landing offset below is 0.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): the new landing level
regions.description: `$07A0` := y + `$9CF2[Y]`: 0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 12, 8, 4, 0, -4, -8, -12, -16, -12, -8, -4 for the direction 0-15, i.e. an aimed hop that points down lands up to 16 px lower than it started, one that points up up to 16 px higher: the enemy works its way toward the player's height. RUN: type `$12` (every hop aimed) landed 6-10 px lower per hop and 15-20 px nearer the player's x, 46 frames a hop.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): restart the picture
regions.description: `JSR $C0A2`: animation phase 0.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): gravity
regions.description: `JSR $C09C` (`$CD12`) with A = `$20`: the y spring pulls the y speed 32/256 a frame toward the target `$0668` = `$FF`, in effect gravity. RUN: a hop with the kick above rises 26 px in 20 frames and falls back; 41 frames in all.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): picture phase 3 reached?
regions.description: The phase `$0638` of 3 or more stops the animation until the next hop.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): picture phase
regions.description: `JSR $C0A5` with step `$40` over 4 phases: a new phase every 4 frames.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): picture tile offset
regions.description: `$06C8` := block base + `$9D06[phase]` (`08 08 04 00`) through `$A1E7`. RUN: offset 8 for the first ~7 frames of a hop, 4 for 4, then 0 until the apex; falling uses 4 (`$9C6F`).

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): move and draw
regions.description: `JSR $C08D`.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): left the screen?
regions.description: `BCC` to the hit test.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): left the screen: made anew
regions.description: `JMP $9B17`: the slot is cleared and, the drawing flags having no bit 4, the type is put back from `$0740`. **The enemy is not gone: next frame it is made again at a random place with full hit points and a new 40-frame introduction.** RUN: pushed off x 255, it came back at (99, 165) with 24 hit points and `$0788` = 40.

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): hit test
regions.description: `JSR $C0C6` (mask `$30`).

regions.name: TYPES $10 / $11 / $12 / $13 (A HOPPING ENEMY): resolve
regions.description: `JMP $C0D2`.

regions.name: Types $10-$13 palette
regions.description: `01 02 00 03` (read at `$9CDE` + type).

regions.name: Hop landing offset by direction
regions.description: 16 signed bytes `00 04 08 0C 10 0C 08 04 00 FC F8 F4 F0 F4 F8 FC`: 4 x the vertical part of directions 0-15 (0 right, 4 down, 8 left, 12 up).

regions.name: Types $10-$13 aim mask
regions.description: `03 01 00 05` (read at `$9CF2` + type): a hop aims at the player when the hop counter AND the mask is 0 - types `$10` every 4th hop, `$11` every 2nd, `$12` every hop, `$13` the 2nd and 8th hop of each 8 (counter mod 8 = 2 or 0).

regions.name: Hop picture tile offset by phase
